why: The site runner's locate (#1693) pins nothing it cannot place: a word the file does not hold settles unlocated WORD_NOT_FOUND, file content that is not canonical base64 of UTF-8 settles unlocated PROVIDER_RESPONSE_MALFORMED, and a timed-out read backs off as a failed check until the request is 120 s old, when it settles unlocated SITE_UNREACHABLE; every request is a read.
